units.source_text: 哥哥回到家的时候，父亲正躺着看报纸。

en.t: When my elder brother came home, Father was lying down reading the newspaper.

units.source_text: 父亲素来有个习惯，什么事都可以不做，唯独报纸不能不读。

en.t: Father had always had a habit: he could leave anything else undone, but he could not go without reading the newspaper.

units.source_text: 由于卧床以后无事可干，就更爱看报了。

en.t: After he was confined to bed and had nothing to do, he became even more fond of reading the paper.

units.source_text: 母亲和我也尽量顺着病人的意愿，没有加以阻止。

en.t: Mother and I also tried to follow the patient's wishes as much as possible and did not stop him.

units.source_text: “爸精神这么好，太好了。

en.t: It is wonderful that Father is in such good spirits.

units.source_text: 我还以为多重呢，这不是挺好的吗？”

en.t: I thought it would be much worse, but isn't he doing quite well?

units.source_text: 哥哥这么说着，跟父亲聊了起来。

en.t: Saying this, my brother began talking with Father.

units.source_text: 他那兴高采烈的语调，我听着不大舒服。

en.t: His cheerful tone did not sound very pleasant to me.

units.source_text: 可是哥哥背着父亲，和我单独在一起时，反倒显得很忧郁。

en.t: But when my brother was away from Father and alone with me, he instead seemed very gloomy.

units.source_text: “不让父亲看报不行吗？”

en.t: Can't you keep Father from reading the newspaper?

units.source_text: “我也这么想，可是他非要看，没办法。”

en.t: I think so too, but he insists on reading it, so there is nothing we can do.

units.source_text: 哥哥默默地听着我的辩白，然后问道：“他看得明白吗？”

en.t: My brother listened silently to my excuse, then asked, Can he understand what he is reading?

units.source_text: 哥哥似乎觉得父亲因为患病，理解力比平时差得多了。

en.t: My brother seemed to think that Father's illness had made his understanding much worse than usual.

units.source_text: “哪里，脑子清楚着呢。

en.t: Not at all, his mind is perfectly clear.

units.source_text: 刚才我在他枕边坐了二十来分钟，聊了好些事儿，一点儿都不糊涂。

en.t: Just now I sat by his pillow for about twenty minutes and talked about all sorts of things, and he was not confused at all.

units.source_text: 看这样子，兴许还能撑不少日子呢。”

en.t: Judging from how he looks, he may still hold out for quite a while.

units.source_text: 跟哥哥前后脚到家的妹夫，比我们还要乐观。

en.t: My sister's husband, who arrived home around the same time as my brother, was even more optimistic than we were.

units.source_text: 父亲向他一一询问了妹妹的情况后说：“她身子那么不方便，还是尽量不要坐火车瞎折腾的好。

en.t: After Father asked him in detail about my sister, he said, With her body in that condition, it would be better for her not to tire herself out by taking the train if she can avoid it.

units.source_text: 她要是非要来看我，我反倒不安。”

en.t: If she insists on coming to see me, it will only make me uneasy.

units.source_text: 父亲又说：“不要紧的，过两天，等我病好了，我就去你们那边看看小外孙，好久都没去了。”

en.t: Father also said, It is all right. In a few days, when I am better, I will go over to your place to see my little grandchild; it has been a long time since I went.
